title: Chai & Kafe - Artisan Indian Bistro
shortDescription: A responsive, modern web platform designed for a dining establishment focusing on performance, high-contrast visual design, fluid menu interactions, and reservation workflows.

detailSections.title: Overview
detailSections.content: Chai & Kafe is an interactive web experience created for a modern dining establishment. It emphasizes visual storytelling, swift page load times, responsive mobile-first navigation, and accessible menu browsing.

detailSections.title: Features & Architecture
detailSections.content:
• Dynamic Menu Filtering: Interactive dish filtering by category, dietary preferences, and chef specials.
• Reservation Engine: Seamless date-time picker and automated party-size inquiry submission form.
• High Performance: Zero bloat, responsive CSS layout grids, smooth scrolling animations, and optimized asset delivery.
